title: The navigation entry's padding fits the full Sales By Representative label without crowding or truncation
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Reports navigation with the entry visible.
custom_steps:
1. Look closely at the "Sales By Representative" entry's label against the entry's left and right edges.
2. Compare its padding with the neighbouring entries.
custom_expected:
1. The full "Sales By Representative" label renders without crowding against the entry's edges and without truncation.
2. The label is not shortened to fit — the fix is the entry's horizontal padding, not the name.
